critique: The render strongly matches the Classic Fractal character: dense orderly particle strings on black, broad flowing fractal ribbons, a central circular void, and clearly evolving geometry between t1 and t4. The cool-blue palette is substantially closer than the initial pass. The remaining visual mismatch is tonal compression at the brightest convergence points and ribbon edges: these areas still rise to pale cyan/near-white, flattening the fine particle detail and reducing the darker layered blue separation expected from the preset.

suggestions.why: Lowering maximum particle opacity should preserve the blue line structure at intense ribbon crossings, reducing pale clipped highlights and restoring more dimensional cool-blue tonal layering.
